To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) we present an attribute image manipulation method that can add, remove or change multiple facial attributes by using either random noise or exemplars as references; (2) we propose a multimodal representation of the attributes that allows the manipulation of both fine and coarse attributes in the style space; (3) we demonstrate that our model can be easily extended for head swapping and face video reenactment.

we propose a novel approach for multi attribute facial image manipulation, where the attributes are semantically guided, and the method is capable of both random and reference attribute transformations, and it can handle multiple attributes simultaneously.

(1) our method is capable to handle both random and guided transformations for multiple attributes; (2) our method can handle multiple attributes at the same time and it can be used for fine grained attribute manipulation; (3) our method is able to handle both fine grained and coarse attributes; and (4) our method can be easily extended in head swapping and face video reenactment.
